name: Gravitational Pull
Gravitational Pulls
desc: You feel a strange tugging sensation.
You're being pulled by an invisible force!
The gravitational pull is overwhelming!
apply_message: You feel gravity shift around you.

name: Gravitational Stress
Gravitational Stresses
desc: Your body is under immense gravitational stress.
The anomaly is crushing you!
You're being torn apart by gravitational forces!
apply_message: The gravitational forces are tearing at your body!
hurt_msg: The gravitational forces crush your body.

name: Gravitational Collapse
Gravitational Collapses
desc: You're at the center of a gravitational anomaly - death is imminent!
apply_message: The anomaly's core is crushing you to death!
remove_message: Somehow, you escape the gravitational collapse.
hurt_msg: Your bones crack under the immense gravitational pressure.

name: Thermal Burns
Thermal Burns
desc: Your skin is burning from extreme heat.
You're suffering severe burns!
The heat is cooking you alive!
hurt_msg: The intense heat burns your flesh.

name: Static Buildup
Static Buildups
desc: Your hair stands on end from static electricity.
Static electricity crackles around you.
You're surrounded by an electrical field!
apply_message: Static electricity builds up around you.

name: Acid Corrosion
Acid Corrosions
desc: Acid is eating away at your equipment and skin.
The corrosive chemicals are dissolving everything!
You're being dissolved by the caustic environment!
apply_message: Acid begins corroding your gear and flesh!
remove_message: The acid stops eating at you.

name: Chemical Burns
Chemical Burns
desc: Caustic chemicals are burning your skin.
The acid is eating through your flesh!
Your body is being dissolved by corrosive chemicals!
hurt_msg: Acid burns deep into your flesh.

name: Frostbite
Frostbites
desc: Your extremities are going numb from cold.
Frostbite is setting into your flesh.
The extreme cold is freezing your body solid!
apply_message: Numbness spreads through your body from the cold.
remove_message: Feeling returns to your frozen limbs.

name: Impaired Movement
Impaired Movements
desc: Your movement is restricted.
You can barely move.
You're almost completely immobilized!

name: Launched
Launched
desc: You've been violently thrown into the air!

name: Fall Impact
Fall Impacts
desc: You're suffering from a hard landing.
The impact has injured you severely.
You've been badly hurt by the fall!
hurt_msg: The impact breaks bones and bruises flesh.

name: Unsteady
Unsteady
desc: The ground feels unstable beneath your feet.
You sense something is wrong with this area.
The surface seems ready to give way!

name: Zone Sickness
Zone Sicknesses
desc: You feel nauseous from prolonged Zone exposure.
The Zone's influence is making you sick.
Your body is rejecting the Zone's unnatural energy.
apply_message: You feel queasy from Zone exposure.

name: Psychic Pressure
Psychic Pressures
desc: You feel an alien presence pressing against your mind.
Something is trying to invade your thoughts.
Your consciousness is under psychic attack!
apply_message: An alien presence presses against your mind.

name: Artifact Resonance
Artifact Resonances
desc: You sense artifacts nearby.
Powerful artifacts are affecting the local area.
The resonance of multiple artifacts is overwhelming!
apply_message: You feel the presence of artifacts.
